title: Is Gran Canaria warm in December?
author: Matt
intro: Yes. Gran Canaria is one of the warmest places within easy reach of the UK in December, with daytime highs of about 23°C and plenty of sun in the south. Evenings are cooler and the sea is fresh rather than warm. Here's what to expect, where to stay and what's on at Christmas.
seo_title: Is Gran Canaria warm in December? About 23°C by day
seo_description: Yes: about 23°C by day, sunnier in the south around Maspalomas, and the sea around 20°C. What to expect, where to stay and Christmas on the island.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Daytime highs:** about 23°C
- **Sea temperature:** around 20°C
- **Sunniest area:** the south coast
- **Flight from London:** about 4½ hours

These are typical averages from climate records, not a forecast. Some December days are cloudier or windier, so check the forecast before you pack.

sections.heading: December weather at a glance
sections.text:
| | December | January |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Daytime high | about 23°C | about 22°C |
| Feel in the evening | mild, take a layer | mild, take a layer |
| Best for | beach and walks | beach and walks |

December is a little warmer than January, and both are far warmer than anywhere in mainland Europe. Days are also longer than at home, with sunset around six o'clock rather than four.

The island has microclimates. The south, around Maspalomas, Playa del Inglés and Puerto de Mogán, is usually sunnier and drier. The north, including the capital Las Palmas, gets more cloud, and the mountains in the middle can be properly cold.

sections.heading: Is it warm enough to swim?
sections.text:
For most people, yes, but it's bracing. The sea around the Canaries is usually about 20°C in December, which feels fresh when you first get in and fine once you're swimming. Many hotels heat their pools in winter, which suits younger children.

Tip: pick a sheltered beach on a windy day. The south coast beaches near Puerto de Mogán and Amadores are calmer than the open dunes at Maspalomas.

sections.heading: Where to stay in December
sections.text:
- **Maspalomas and Playa del Inglés:** the most reliable sun, the famous dunes and lots of choice, from big resorts to apartments.
- **Puerto de Mogán:** a pretty harbour town in the south-west, quieter and good for couples and families.
- **Las Palmas:** a real city with a long town beach, Las Canteras, better for a city break with some sun than a lazy beach week.

If the weather matters most, stay in the south and visit Las Palmas for a day.

sections.heading: Christmas and New Year on the island
sections.text:
Gran Canaria makes a lot of Christmas, without the cold. Las Palmas usually builds a big nativity scene out of sand on Las Canteras beach, and towns put up lights and markets through December.

- **Christmas Eve:** Nochebuena is the main family meal, and many restaurants run set menus, so book ahead.
- **New Year's Eve:** fireworks and parties along the seafronts, with the tradition of eating twelve grapes at midnight.
- **5 January:** the Three Kings parades, the biggest children's event of the season.

Local knowledge: flights and hotels for the Christmas and New Year weeks sell out early and cost the most. The first two weeks of December are warm, quieter and much better value.

sections.heading: Getting there and what to pack
sections.text:
There are direct flights to Gran Canaria from most big UK and Irish airports in winter, taking about four to four and a half hours. The Canaries are on the same time as the UK, so there's no jet lag, which makes a short winter break easy even with young children.

- **Daytime:** shorts, t-shirts, swimwear and strong sun cream. The winter sun is stronger than it feels.
- **Evenings:** a light jumper or jacket, as it cools down quickly after sunset.
- **Day trips:** a warm layer and proper shoes for the mountains, where Roque Nublo and the high villages can be 10 degrees colder than the coast.

If you're flying over Christmas, book early: the Canaries are among the most popular winter-sun choices from the UK, and prices climb as the dates get closer.

sections.heading: Where else is warm in December?
sections.text:
If Gran Canaria isn't quite right, [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) is similar, at about 22°C, with Mount Teide for a day out. [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) is slightly cooler and drier, and [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura) has the biggest beaches. Our [Gran Canaria or Tenerife](/blog/gran-canaria-or-tenerife) guide compares the two, and the [where to go in December](/destinations/where-to-go-in-december) page has more ideas.

If your family can't agree on one island, add a few to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: How warm is Gran Canaria in December?
faqs.answer: Daytime highs are usually about 23°C, with mild evenings. The south of the island is usually sunnier and drier than the north.

faqs.question: Can you swim in the sea in Gran Canaria in December?
faqs.answer: Yes. The sea is usually around 20°C, which feels fresh at first. Many hotels heat their pools in winter.

faqs.question: Which part of Gran Canaria is best in December?
faqs.answer: The south, around Maspalomas, Playa del Inglés and Puerto de Mogán, has the most reliable sun. Las Palmas in the north is cloudier.

faqs.question: Is Gran Canaria warmer than Tenerife in December?
faqs.answer: They're very similar, at around 22 to 23°C by day. Both have sunnier south coasts and cloudier north coasts.
